statements.subject: state_machine
statements.description: After the peer fails to respond to Configure-Requests, an implementation MAY wait passively for the peer to send Configure-Requests.
statements.trigger: TO- event (peer fails to respond to Configure-Requests)
statements.pre_cond: peer.configure_request_response = absent & (protocol.state = Req-Sent | protocol.state = Ack-Rcvd | protocol.state = Ack-Sent)
actions: wait passively for peer to send Configure-Requests
suppress This-Layer-Finished action for TO- event in states Req-Sent, Ack-Rcvd, and Ack-Sent

statements.subject: ppp
statements.description: This option is useful for dedicated circuits, or circuits which have no status signals available, but SHOULD NOT be used for switched circuits.

statements.subject: state_machine
statements.description: When entering the Opened state, the implementation SHOULD signal the upper layers that it is now Up.

statements.subject: state_machine
statements.description: Conversely, when leaving the Opened state, the implementation SHOULD signal the upper layers that it is now Down.
